objective: Measure native arm64 concurrent environment scaling on the six-character production scenario.
measurement_definition: Aggregate rate is the sum of each concurrently completed process's reported measured physics steps/s; each worker has an isolated temporary write directory that is removed after its tier, while raw stdout logs are retained.
caveat: One sweep on one map; no learner/inference load, core placement control, thermal-repeat average, or cross-architecture physics-equivalence claim.
